name: Mindful Health Solutions
one_liner: Psychiatry clinics offering TMS, Spravato (esketamine) and IV ketamine for hard-to-treat depression, plus medication management, in CA, WA and TX.
best_for: Adults with depression that has not improved after two or more antidepressants
People wanting TMS or Spravato covered by insurance, including Kaiser and Medicare members
People in California, Washington or Texas near one of its clinics
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988; for immediate danger call 911
People looking for weekly talk therapy as their main treatment
People who cannot travel to a clinic regularly (TMS and Spravato are in person)
short_description: Interventional psychiatry clinics in CA, WA and TX for treatment-resistant depression: TMS, Spravato, IV ketamine and medication management.
long_description: Mindful Health Solutions is a psychiatric group practice with more than 20 clinics in California (including San Francisco, Oakland, Burlingame, San Rafael, Sacramento, Roseville, El Dorado Hills and Los Angeles), Washington and Texas (including Austin and Houston). It focuses on depression that has not responded to standard treatment, offering transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS, including an accelerated one-day protocol called MindfulONE), Spravato (esketamine) nasal spray, IV ketamine infusions, and in-person or video medication management. It is in-network with Kaiser, Medicare and most major commercial plans for TMS, Spravato and psychiatry, and its team handles prior authorization; IV ketamine is generally self-pay ($450 per induction session and $400 per maintenance session on its FAQ). A company-funded 2024 study of its own patients compared TMS with usual care. It is a different company from 'Mindful Health' in Texas.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance for TMS, Spravato and psychiatry; IV ketamine $450/session self-pay
pricing.notes: In-network with Kaiser, Medicare and most major commercial plans; TMS and Spravato usually need prior authorization after two failed antidepressant trials. IV ketamine: $450 per induction session (first 6), $400 per maintenance session, generally not billed to insurance but may be HSA/FSA eligible; another vendor page lists $600, so confirm.

privacy.notes: Website policy says it does not sell, share or rent your information beyond what it discloses; it does not describe deletion rights, and no HIPAA notice was reviewed in this check.

clinical_trials.study: TMS versus usual care for major depression among Mindful Health Solutions patients

citation.authors: Bastiaens J, Brown N, Bermudes RA, Juusola JL, Bravata DM, Marton TF
citation.title: Utilization and outcomes of transcranial magnetic stimulation and usual care for MDD in a large group psychiatric practice

clinical_trials.outcome: Of 1,011 eligible patients, only 89 completed a full TMS course; non-randomized comparison with usual care; all authors paid by Mindful Health Solutions.

patient_summary: You are referred or call an intake specialist, who checks your insurance and whether you qualify for treatments like TMS or Spravato, which usually require that at least two antidepressants have not worked. Treatment is given in person at one of its clinics, and medication management can be in person or by video; most treatments are billed to insurance, while IV ketamine is self-pay.

availability.note: More than 20 in-person clinics in California, Washington and Texas; medication management also by video. IV ketamine at San Francisco, Oakland, Sacramento and Austin.
